audience: compliance teams that run their own KYC and AML screening with dilisense

useCases.title: Screen a person against watchlists
useCases.text: Screen a person against sanction, PEP and criminal lists. Give either all fields or name fields, not both.

useCases.title: Screen a company against watchlists
useCases.text: Screen a company or other legal entity against sanction, PEP and criminal lists.

useCases.title: Search adverse media for a person
useCases.text: Search adverse media news for a person by category, such as fraud or corruption.

useCases.title: Check which source lists the key searches
useCases.text: List the screening source lists with their ids and countries, and see which lists your key searches.
